## Appearance

Matthew is an odd-looking personage with an ungainly figure, stooping shoulders, and kindly brown eyes that gleam with pride. He has long iron-gray hair that reaches his shoulders, complemented by a full, soft brown beard.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P34](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0034)_

## Personality

Matthew is an exceptionally shy, reticent, and quiet man who naturally avoids excitement and hates being among strangers. He possesses a mortal dread of little girls and rarely speaks, making him notably non-confrontational, yet he holds fast to his opinions with an amazing silent persistency. Despite his unobservant nature, he is wise, patient, and good-natured, serving as a sympathetic listener who never scolds. He is extremely hardworking, to the point that stopping work would be like stopping breathing. Matthew is warmly admiring, dispositioned toward keeping [Anne](../character/anne.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), and gently encourages her to hold onto a little of her romance.

## History

[Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and his sister [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) lived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), having grown up before the new house was built. Having worn a soft brown beard since he was twenty, Matthew drove to the train station to pick up an orphan boy, but instead brought home [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Although [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) initially intended to return the girl, Matthew persistently desired to keep her, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) ultimately agreed. He consistently supported [Anne](../character/anne.md), encouraging her enthusiasm when [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) criticized her activities and gently advising her on matters of romance and imagination. On one [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas), Matthew braved his shyness to buy [Anne](../character/anne.md) a stylish brown dress with puffed sleeves after noticing how plain her clothing was compared to her peers. When [Anne](../character/anne.md) placed first on the island for the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) entrance examinations, she proudly shared the news with Matthew and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Later, Matthew helped [Anne](../character/anne.md) prepare for her departure to Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) as she pursued her higher education.

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--matthew.md)

Matthew forms an immediate, gentle bond with [Anne](../character/anne.md), quietly advocating for her to remain at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) from the moment she arrives. They become the best of friends, sharing a deep trust and mutual affection where [Anne](../character/anne.md) confides in him openly. Even when [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) threatens to send [Anne](../character/anne.md) away or strictly punishes her, Matthew silently supports [Anne](../character/anne.md) and takes joy in her imaginative presence.

- Friend of — best of friends who talk and share confidences  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P8](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0008)</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--matthew.md)

Matthew loves [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) effortlessly and without reservation from their very first meeting. He frequently spends time with her around the farm, quietly backing her desire to stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and indulge in local outings like the Sunday-school picnic. His easy affection provides [Anne](../character/anne.md) with a soft, comforting contrast to Marilla's stricter discipline.

- Friend of — loved immediately and easily without trouble  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017)</sub>
